en: Dependent on a state that is a root with an internal object, there arises a state that is not a root and does not have an internal object, by way of root condition. (In all cases, three.

Dependent on a state that is a root with an external object, there arises a state that is not a root and does not have an external object, by way of root condition. ... [Under] root [condition], three; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance [condition], three.
